dashboards.name: Bootstrap CI Baselines
dashboards.feature: Subject-level bootstrap CI for patient-specific accuracy/sensitivity + cross-patient accuracy; literature benchmark comparison (Shoeb 2010, Truong 2018)

dashboards.feature: PNES vs epilepsy semiological scoring, diagnostic certainty (documented/probable/clinically established), vEEG urgency triage, PHQ-9/GAD-7 distribution, psychiatric comorbidity analysis
dashboards.why: PNES affects 2-33/100k; up to 20% of epilepsy monitoring unit admissions. Misdiagnosis delays correct psychiatric treatment by avg 7 years. Differential requires simultaneous neurological + psychiatric lens.
